hero.title: Everyone has a guess. Only a market has a number.
hero.lead: Buy YES or NO on a real event. The chain holds the collateral and settles the outcome.

claim.manifesto: A price is an opinion someone had to pay for.
claim.sub: That is the whole argument for a prediction market, and the only one this page makes.

cost.title: It costs something to be wrong
